CommunityApplications.Profile:
**JLTamp** is a self-hosted music server by JLT Electronics, with its own apps for Android, iOS, CarPlay and Android Auto, a built-in web player and a Subsonic/OpenSubsonic API.
This repository ships one template: **JLTamp-Server** (ghcr.io/jltelectronics/jltamp-server, amd64 and arm64).
Questions and bug reports: [GitHub issues](https://github.com/JLTelectronics/JLTamp-server/issues).
